title: Implement LambdaRank pseudo-gradients
prompt: Return LambdaRank LOSS pseudo-gradients for one query using exponential gain 2^label-1 and NDCG@k swap weights. Ranks are frozen for the step, equal-label pairs are skipped, and gradient descent subtracts these gradients. IDCG=0 or k=0 gives zeros. Ties follow input row order.
